goal: Record course milestones and prepare the execution plan

in_scope: Record the approved nine milestone groups and their concrete deliverables in the delivery plan and backlog.
Define work groups and handoff criteria for all milestones, including module integration and final audit inputs. The user selects any milestone scope at execution.
out_of_scope: Claim or start any content Story, author content, change the approved baseline, merge or publish.
Add a checkpoint policy, effort or time forecasts, or a scheduling engine.

constraints: Use the approved SDA-v1 outline unchanged and retain all existing backlog IDs, Story scopes, dependencies and Planned statuses.
Retain draft-only authoring, both independent reviews, per-module coverage and explicit human approval.
The user can select one, several or all nine milestones in the same run. Use concrete draft artifact dependencies for readiness across the selection. Milestone IDs identify deliverables.

definition_of_done.text: Record nine milestones and an actionable execution plan with user-selected run scope and all handoff conditions.
Verify complete and unique milestone assignment, dependency-aware work, and an unchanged approved baseline.

acceptance_criteria.text: Assign every Story to exactly one milestone, preserving all existing content packages and mapped topics.
Execution plan allows any subset of milestones or the whole backlog in one run, identifies concrete inputs and preserves module validation and audit gates.
Pass required repository checks, strict baseline coverage, and milestone and backlog integrity verification.
